purpose: Deferred framework investigation inventory, owned by tasks/88.md and tasks/89.md. It is outside the current two-stage plan and adds no Stage A or implemented-Node gate.

oracle.invocation: node <// Flags:> test/parallel/<fixture> from a byte-identical copy of tests/node/test outside quench-v2 (the root package.json declares type=module, which changes .js fixtures to ESM); NODE_TEST_DIR per fixture; TEST_THREAD_ID per worker; 90 s timeout

scenarios.required: Every scenario matches local Node: status, headers (Date only by format), body bytes, exit status.

membership_rule: A builtin enters when any pinned framework package requests it (trace/requests.cjs); tls enters as the base of https/http2; web_globals enters for undici/WHATWG globals the scenarios load or call. Each entered builtin contributes every upstream test/parallel test-*.{js,mjs,cjs} whose name matches its family prefixes: the name after 'test-' equals a prefix or continues it with '-' or '.'. Families are disjoint; tools/check-task-coherence.mjs rejects overlaps, omissions and changed hashes.

pass.reason: The local oracle passes the fixture; production quench-node must match it.

expose_internals.reason: The fixture requests --expose-internals and tests Node internals, not public behavior.

skip.reason: Node itself skips the fixture on the qualification host.

fail.reason: The local oracle does not pass the pinned (newer) fixture. Task 88 aligns the oracle with the pinned suite; each fixture then becomes required or receives a named, reasoned rule. A Quench failure is never a rule.

timeout.reason: As fail: the oracle did not complete within the timeout.

membership_derivation: An entry's membership is rules[oracle].membership; its frameworks are families[builtin].frameworks.
